items.title: Teledyne Technologies (TDY) Lands Europe Space And Defence Roles In Fresh Win
items.summary: Teledyne Technologies (NYSE:TDY) said it is supplying advanced imaging detectors for Europe's Sentinel-3C and Fluorescence Explorer Earth observation satellites. The company disclosed a separate award to provide specialist energetics for next-generation unmanned defence systems programs in Europe. Teledyne plans to deliver imaging hardware that supports environmental monitoring missions focused on oceans, land surfaces and atmospheric conditions.
